findings.title: The real consumer admits missing pre-main evidence as a clean test verdict
findings.requirement: §4 D03 / finite inventory: missing/unknown/incomplete evidence must not become a clean verdict; missing END remains incompleteness.
findings.mechanism: The new native assertions permit any MISSING_PHASE_COMPLETION and require only ENTRY_READY_WRITE_BEGIN in completed. The decoder correctly marks missing evidence INCOMPLETE, but the real consumer does not inspect status or which phases are missing, then can publish status PASS_SOURCE_NOT_INSTALLED.

source_reproducer.actual: All three decode INCOMPLETE with MISSING_PHASE_COMPLETION, yet the exact AST-extracted new consumer assertions at lines3583/3586 pass. Removing CONVERSATION_TURN_API_IMPORT_BEGIN END or all CONVERSATION_MODULE_BEGIN rows from an otherwise complete trace also leaves all legacy nonphase assertions unaffected.
source_reproducer.positive: Complete evidence decodes OBSERVED and passes the same assertions.

findings.impact: Observer drift/lost required ENTER or END is not an admission blocker for the existing native acceptance test. This does not claim an actual native false PASS was executed.
findings.minimal_remedy: Require every known pre-READY phase to have entered/completed. If teardown legitimately interrupts runpy/module/main, allow only those exact pending long-lived boundaries, explicitly preserve INCOMPLETE, and do not blanket-exempt all missing completions. Add same-consumer SOURCE negative controls for a missing import END and missing entire pre-main label.

findings.title: The decoder rejects the existing normal SystemExit teardown records as unknown events
findings.requirement: D03 must integrate with the existing real consumer and producer without treating supported ordinary cleanup as unknown input; keep private traceback details out of the report.
findings.mechanism: The unchanged BOOTSTRAP except BaseException tail emits bootstrap-exception/bootstrap-frame/bootstrap-source for SystemExit(0). None of those event types is in public_statuses, so UNKNOWN_EVENT is added and line3583 fails. Actual inert entry installs SIGTERM handler at163, _log_signal ends sys.exit(0) at145, and RuntimeHost.stop sends SIGTERM at670/673 before kill/reap. Thus this is a supported producer/consumer path, not merely an arbitrary unknown event fixture.

source_reproducer.actual: The exact BOOTSTRAP emitter, observer and exception/finally tail on synthetic fixed source paths run through READY_WRITE END then SystemExit(0), child exit0/no stdout/no stderr, 17 phase events and the seven expected pre-READY completions. Decoder returns INCOMPLETE with MISSING_PHASE_COMPLETION and UNKNOWN_EVENT; exact line3583 consumer assertion rejects it.
source_reproducer.live_limit: No native or signal launch. Ordinary signal path is traced in real source; reachability/output is SOURCE-reproduced at its SystemExit boundary, not an observed fresh native result.

findings.minimal_remedy: Handle the known ordinary teardown in the existing producer before emitting arbitrary exception/frame/source rows, or classify those known legacy categories safely without projecting their private statuses. Preserve exception failure/incomplete distinction and do not broadly suppress truly unknown or denial events. Add an exact observer-tail SystemExit control to the same SOURCE selection.
